findings.detail: CSafe First Lien Term Loan identifier carries maturity 2028-12-04, but the source row maturity is 2028-12-14.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The raw SOI rows show the maturity date matching the structured/XBRL value for each flagged holding and disagreeing with the date embedded in the extracted identifier/Agent A parsed value. The defect is localized to identifier/date extraction rather than the source schedule or structured maturity field.
